parameter.name: mathmlDescription
parameter.shortdesc: The MathML description to create the SVG from. (Optional)

parameter.name: mathmlDestinationPage
parameter.shortdesc: The page on which to create the object. (Optional)

parameter.name: destinationLayer
parameter.shortdesc: The layer on which to create the Object. Uses active document layer by default (Optional)

parameter.name: placePoint
parameter.shortdesc: The point where to place the object (only applicable if page is provided) (Optional)

parameter.name: withProperties
parameter.shortdesc: Initial values for properties of the new MathObject (Optional)

method.name: count
method.shortdesc: Displays the number of elements in the MathObject.

method.name: item
method.shortdesc: Returns the MathObject with the specified index or name.

parameter.name: index
parameter.shortdesc: The index or name. Can accept: Long Integer or String.

method.name: itemByName
method.shortdesc: Returns the MathObject with the specified name.

method.name: itemByID
method.shortdesc: Returns the MathObject with the specified ID.

method.name: itemByRange
method.shortdesc: Returns the MathObjects within the specified range.

parameter.name: from
parameter.shortdesc: The MathObject, index, or name at the beginning of the range. Can accept: MathObject, Long Integer or String.

parameter.name: to
parameter.shortdesc: The MathObject, index, or name at the end of the range. Can accept: MathObject, Long Integer or String.

method.name: firstItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the first MathObject in the collection.

method.name: lastItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the last MathObject in the collection.

method.name: middleItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the middle MathObject in the collection.

method.name: previousItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the MathObject with the index previous to the specified index.

parameter.name: obj
parameter.shortdesc: The index of the MathObject that follows the desired MathObject.

method.name: nextItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the MathObject whose index follows the specified MathObject in the collection.

parameter.name: obj
parameter.shortdesc: The MathObject whose index comes before the desired MathObject.

method.name: anyItem
method.shortdesc: Returns any MathObject in the collection.

method.name: everyItem
method.shortdesc: Returns every MathObject in the collection.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the MathObject.
Returns the MathObject with the specified index.

property.name: length
property.shortdesc: The number of objects in the collection.
